d: An established organisation in Saudi Arabia is seeking a Director of Legal to lead its legal function and advise senior leadership on corporate, commercial, and regulatory matters.
The successful candidate will combine strong knowledge of Saudi laws with practical commercial judgement, protecting the organisation’s interests and supporting its strategic objectives.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Law or Sharia; a postgraduate qualification is preferred.
Substantial legal experience in Saudi Arabia, including senior leadership responsibility within an established organisation or reputable law firm.
Strong knowledge of Saudi corporate, commercial, employment, and regulatory matters.
Proven experience negotiating complex agreements and managing significant disputes.
Experience advising executive leadership and boards.
Excellent negotiation, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills.
Professional fluency in Arabic and English, including legal drafting.
A Saudi licence to practise law or another recognised legal professional qualification is preferred.
Relevant qualifications in corporate governance, compliance, or arbitration are an advantage.
r: Develop and lead the organisation’s legal strategy, priorities, and operating model.
Advise senior leadership on legal risks, commercial transactions, and strategic initiatives.
Oversee the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts and agreements.
Advise on corporate governance, board and shareholder matters, and delegated authorities.
Manage litigation, disputes, settlements, and external legal counsel.
Support employment, procurement, technology, and investment matters.
Monitor legal and regulatory developments and guide the implementation of required changes.
Build and develop the legal team, policies, templates, and contract management processes.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

We are looking for an experienced User Reach & Lifecycle professional with a strong background in the crypto industry, exceptional data-driven thinking, and proven leadership capabilities.

This is a leadership pipeline position. The successful candidate will initially take ownership of key business initiatives, with the opportunity to progressively assume team leadership responsibilities based on performance and demonstrated capabilities.

The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of crypto user behavior, trading products, and market dynamics, with the ability to drive the evolution of user engagement toward data-driven personalization, intelligent recommendations, and automated reach.
q: 5+ years of relevant experience in crypto exchanges , with a deep understanding of exchange products, business models, and user lifecycles.
Proven experience in personalization, recommendation systems, intelligent CRM , or algorithm-driven growth projects , with the ability to design and implement effective engagement strategies.
Exceptional data sense and analytical thinking , with strong capabilities in user behavior analysis, segmentation, conversion funnels, and experimentation.
Strong understanding of crypto trading behaviors, asset preferences, market sensitivity, and core trading products, including Spot and Derivatives.
Hands-on experience building automated engagement or lifecycle management frameworks, with a track record of scaling operational strategies.
Previous people management experience , including goal setting, team development, and cross-functional collaboration.
Strong project ownership and execution capabilities , with a proven track record of driving complex initiatives from 0 to 1 and delivering measurable business results.
Highly ambitious, resilient, results-oriented, and accountable , with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
Fluent in both English and Chinese as working languages , and willing to be based in Abu Dhabi, UAE.
r: Develop systematic lifecycle engagement strategies covering registration, KYC, first deposit/trade, activation, retention, churn prevention, and reactivation.
Segment users based on behavioral data, trading activity, asset holdings, and product preferences to deliver targeted engagement strategies.
Optimize lifecycle conversion funnels to improve trading activity, retention, reactivation, and long-term user value.
Design personalized engagement strategies and recommendation logic based on user behavior, interests, lifecycle stages, and real-time context.
Collaborate with Product, Data, and Algorithm teams to develop and implement user profiling, recommendation rules, and intelligent decision-making capabilities.
Establish recommendation prioritization, user-content matching, and performance evaluation mechanisms to improve relevance and conversion.
Develop systematic market-triggered engagement strategies based on price movements, market trends, asset holdings, watchlists, and trading preferences.
Build real-time or near-real-time engagement triggers and optimize message relevance, timing, and frequency.
Improve the alignment between market insights and user interests to drive trading engagement and conversion.
Develop intelligent and automated engagement strategies across Push, Email, Inbox, In-App, Banner, Popup, and other owned channels.
Design automated engagement scenarios and trigger logic based on user lifecycle stages, behavioral signals, and market events.
Establish cross-channel prioritization, frequency capping, suppression rules, and channel orchestration to improve efficiency and user experience.
Drive the implementation and scaling of automated engagement capabilities while reducing manual operations.
Establish key performance metrics for user engagement and lifecycle management, leveraging funnel analysis, user segmentation, cohort analysis, and A/B testing.
Evaluate engagement effectiveness and incremental business impact to continuously optimize strategies.
Drive measurable improvements in user activation, trading conversion, retention, and reactivation.
Lead complex cross-functional initiatives involving Product, Data, Algorithm, Engineering, and business teams, ensuring successful execution and measurable outcomes.
Develop clear project roadmaps, priorities, and milestones while proactively resolving execution challenges.
Demonstrate strong people management and talent development capabilities, with the potential to take on broader team leadership responsibilities.
